propositions: complexity-baseline.json lacks a CI lock against main, unlike module-size-limit.txt, allowing any contributor to modify the baseline without administrator override
The baseline can grow by adding new high-complexity function entries that match the live function count, bypassing the current gate which only guards schema, sortedness, and entry staleness
The lock mechanism must be semantic (comparing ceilings mappings entry-by-entry), not byte-equality, to allow legitimate shrinkage (removed or lowered entries) while rejecting raises and additions
The module-size limit's lock currently fails open with a warning when git fetch of main fails, allowing unverified limit changes to pass; both locks must fail closed instead
CI must reject added entries or raised ceilings in complexity-baseline.json unless an administrator overrides, while permitting removed entries or lowered ceilings without override
